scoring_justification: T1 recompute: Mechanical properties (E, σ_y, ε_b) are recomputed from the agent's raw stress-strain CSV. Values are compared with paper-reported targets within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference mechanical properties for AGNR, CGNR, ZGNR from Table 1
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly extracted from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values match the paper's published mechanical properties for the same conditions.

outputs.description: Complete time series of engineering stress and strain for three GNR types under uniaxial tension at 300 K. The checker recomputes Young's modulus (low-strain slope), yielding strength (maximum stress), and breaking strain (strain at fracture) from this raw data and compares the derived values to the paper's reported quantities.

output_contract.notes: The additional outputs for Cauchy-Born ratios, high-temperature bond-flips, and SW dislocation energies were removed because the toolchain could not provision corresponding solve blocks. The task scope reverts to the original 300 K mechanical properties, which are the main headline result.
